9to5Mac Daily records new episodes every Monday through Friday. Subscribe now on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast platform to make sure new episodes land in your ears the moment they're released.

Today's news discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no intention of supporting Apple's all-new iPhone Handoff feature
  • Disney+ and Hulu have raised their prices—here's a look at the latest charges
  • Apple says a software update to fix the iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug will be released next week
  • An iPhone 18 Pro Face ID bug is causing some users' systems to crash and restart
  • The iOS 27.0.1 update will be rolling out to iPhone very soon
